name: blueprint-helper
description: Codex-facing BlueprintHelper workflow plugin for Unreal Editor lifecycle through MCP and ordinary asset workflows through the CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Use BlueprintHelper CLI for UE assets and MCP for editor lifecycle.
interface.longDescription: BlueprintHelper guides Codex through Unreal Editor asset reads and TaskSpec-first Blueprint, UMG, DataAsset, DataTable, compile, save, open, diagnostics, and Codex configuration workflows. The Codex plugin exposes the CLI-first workflow for ordinary tools, a configure skill for safety/profile preferences, and registers the MCP endpoint only for editor lifecycle commands.
defaultPrompt: Inspect a Blueprint with BlueprintHelper CLI
Configure BlueprintHelper safety profile for Codex
Preview a TaskSpec before executing an edit
